title: p10-extension-pack
purpose: PACK-10 probe (first-class extends): clinicbase composed with a throwaway extension pack ('clinicext') that uses the first-class `extends` keyword to additively contribute a bloodType field onto clinicbase::Patient.
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo -- serves the PACK-10 live proof and nothing else.
clinicbase is a TRANSITIVE dependency (declared only by packs/clinicext/pack.json's own packs[]), never $ref'd directly by model.json.
Built for PACK-10 first-class extends verification; not intended to be run by hand.
expectedOutcomes: clinicbase::Patient ends up with both name (from base) and bloodType (from extension) after composition.
The first-class `extends` keyword is accepted by the schema and processed by PackExtensionComposer.
The generated app has a single Patient table with both columns.
